name: Construction Manager Bot
tagline: Field-side construction manager: photo a site issue, get a card and a draft RFI
description: Built for a phone on an active civil site: photograph a problem and it produces a structured card describing the issue, with a draft RFI to match. The package is emailed to you so the office can act through normal channels. Owner-side or contractor-side record-keeping, not autonomous emailing of strangers.
author: HenryBeagle808
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
